scope: Native admission of the complete SemanticProgramEnvelopeV1 as one object (exact envelope/core keys, schema literals, deep-equality with the separately transported duplicates, adoption of envelope-only components) and native source attestation (semanticSourceDescriptor + attestSemanticProgramSource ports: SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes, UTF-8/UTF-16 lengths, a faithful parseGeometrySourceRoutingHeader port, and the UTF-16 surrogate-pair span-endpoint check for provenance/diagnostics spans) behind the WASM ABI
coverage: Unified envelope object admitted natively: a present graph-begin envelope field must be an object with exactly ['schema','schemaVersion','source','core','provenance','tessellationIntents','diagnostics'], schema === 'semantic-program-envelope', a supported 1.2 schemaVersion, and a core with exactly the 14 validateCore keys and schema === 'semantic-program-core'

Envelope consistency semantics (chosen: duplicates must match exactly): every component transported both as a top-level graph-begin field and inside the envelope must be deep-equal; components carried only inside the envelope are adopted into admission; execution inputs remain the top-level fields, so the envelope can never silently supersede what executes

Native source attestation (port of attestSemanticProgramSource and semanticSourceDescriptor): when the request transports sourceText, its exact UTF-8 bytes are SHA-256-hashed and compared to source.sha256, its UTF-8 byte length and UTF-16 code-unit length (computed from the decoded string) are compared to source.utf8ByteLength/utf16CodeUnitLength, and the 250,000-unit / 4,000,000-byte source limits are enforced

Faithful Rust port of parseGeometrySourceRoutingHeader: line splitting on CR/LF/CRLF, block-comment/string masking with escape tracking, @language/@requires/@engine directive recognition with the JavaScript \s whitespace set, header-placement and duplication rules, capability identifier syntax and the 32-capability budget; the parsed languageContract must equal language.contract and the sorted unique @requires set must equal declaredCapabilities

Surrogate-pair span-endpoint check enabled natively when sourceText is present: every provenance span start/end and every non-null diagnostics span start/end must not fall between a high and a low surrogate; endpoints at pair edges and at the text end admit; absent sourceText keeps descriptor-only admission with the check skipped (optional-but-strict)

Admission runs inside brep_envelope::validate in prepare, after execution-plan validation and before Runner::new, so every refusal precedes all node execution; requests without envelope/sourceText behave exactly as before

executeBrepNativeProgram now transports the trusted lowering's program as the envelope object and its exact source text (threaded through SemanticLoweringSuccess.sourceText from the lowerer input) with zero added host-side validation logic; a real lowered OpenSCAD difference program executes natively, and tampered source text, tampered descriptors and a mid-surrogate provenance span refuse with E_BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT and zero onNode progress callbacks

Wrong-by-one native coverage: extra/missing envelope key, wrong envelope schema literal, wrong envelope schema version, extra/missing core key, valid-but-different envelope component (declared capability and closure), envelope nodes mismatch against the executing top-level nodes, envelope-only forged provenance adopted and refused, sha256 with one flipped hex character, utf8ByteLength/utf16CodeUnitLength off by one in both directions, missing descriptor/language/declaredCapabilities context, non-string sourceText, provenance and diagnostics span endpoints mid-pair (including empty diagnostic spans) versus pair edges and the text-end boundary, routing-header language/capability mismatches, unsupported contract, duplicated @language, @engine selection, malformed reserved directive, directive after body, and @requires deduplication
behaviorChange: Graph/session admission now admits the unified SemanticProgramEnvelopeV1 object and, when the exact source text is transported, attests it natively (digest, lengths, routing header, surrogate-safe span endpoints) before any node executes; requests carrying tampered envelope objects, source text, descriptors or mid-surrogate spans fail with BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT instead of executing geometry. Requests without envelope/sourceText behave exactly as before.
limitations: validateOccurrenceProduction replay (semanticProgramValidator.ts l.1381) remains host-side; native occurrence admission covers the identity subset only
$expansion continuation and module-activation anchoring (l.600/669), including the runtime ancestor-chain walk for staticParent, remain host-side
Occurrence identity admission still requires operations on the request; provenance admission inherits the same context requirement
The surrogate-pair span-endpoint check and routing-header attestation run only when sourceText is transported; descriptor-only requests keep the previous behavior with the check skipped

Envelope admission requires deep-equality between duplicated components rather than letting the envelope supersede them; an envelope-only request is admitted but execution still consumes the top-level fields
The application executor replacement remains open
